scripts.title: Shatter all gl*
scripts.features: shatter all glass in the game causing lag and confusion or something AI would say idk vro
scripts.script:
local rep = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
local remote = rep.Remotes.ShatterGlass

local folder = workspace.WorldMap.Ultility.Windows
for _, glass in pairs(folder:GetDescendants()) do
    if glass.Name:lower():find('glass') and glass:IsA('BasePart') then
        local pos = glass.Position
        local dir = Vector3.new(0, 100, 0)
        remote:FireServer(glass, pos, dir)
    end
end

scripts.title: Inf Ammo
scripts.features:
Features:

Unlimited Ammo:
Sets both the Ammo and MaxAmmo values to math.huge, allowing for endless firing without reload.

Dynamic Table Scanning:
Uses getgc(true) to search through all accessible tables and find the one containing Ammo and MaxAmmo. This avoids hardcoding specific variable paths.

Read-only Bypass:
If the located table is read-only, the script disables the read-only restriction using setreadonly().

Requirements:

Access to exploit functions like getgc(), setreadonly(), and rawset().
scripts.script:
local get = getgc(true)

for _, t in next, get do
    if type(t) == 'table' and rawget(t, "Ammo") and rawget(t, "MaxAmmo") then
        if isreadonly(t) then
            setreadonly(t, false)
        end
        rawset(t, "Ammo", math.huge)
        rawset(t, "MaxAmmo", math.huge)
    end
end
